name: XMLSchemaReference
description: Represents an individual schema that is attached to a document.
remarks: Use the XMLSchemaReference property to return an XMLSchemaReference object for a ChildNodeSuggestion object. The following example inserts the suggested XML child element if the XML schema referenced is the SimpleSample schema.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified XMLSchemaReference object.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the schema namespace for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the physical location of an XML schema. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified XML Schema Reference.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the XML schemas that are referenced in a document.
